description: Fork of exp234 (1.6212 @ 8K, 358M, d_v=32). Single change: drop rank-canonicalization (out_v2d + out_d2v) after out_proj — replace with plain LayerNorm(E). Residual stream now keeps real-valued out_proj magnitude info instead of being projected into ranking-only space. Tests whether the rank canonicalization between blocks (descended from exp071) was bottlenecking the trunk.
